rationale: Protected-line impedance magnitude is 26.387876 ohm. Zone 1 uses an underreach within 0.78-0.85 of the protected line. Zone 2 covers the protected line plus the allowed fraction of the shortest remote line. Zone 3 covers the protected line plus the allowed fraction of the longest remote line and remains below the 0.8 load-encroachment limit of 121 ohm. Delays are inside the specified coordination windows and nondecreasing.
